definitions.time: Initial state t0; step t settles the two actions chosen at state t-1. Windows exclude the start state and include the end state. Earliest among equal maxima; windows overlap across lengths.
definitions.lead: Opponent cash minus candidate cash, seats in unmodified seat0/seat1 order. First sustained = 20 consecutive strictly positive after-turn states. Ties interrupt streaks. Every game is included.
definitions.terminal: Extinction adjustment is added only to official score, excluded from operating cash windows. A negative net winner-transfer or cancelled purchase must not be inferred from gross cargo.
definitions.cash_events: [kind, credited/debited seat, signed actual cash change, entity ID and cell if applicable]. Trees include terrain and enemy-cargo absorption. Deposits are net of smelt and may include cargo from a prior collision; collision cash excludes cargo intercepted by a surviving collector. Rounding is separately charged.
definitions.workers: workers[id]=[position, cargo, is_collector, seat, nearest-own-base toroidal distance]. Impassable threats and actual future moves are excluded from geometric distance. Collision row=[dead ID, owner, pre-settlement cargo, beneficiary or null, surviving-collector seat or null].
definitions.scope: Complete transcript and score per listed run. Games from a shared map and two seats are dependent. These trajectories are observational; action alternatives have no labels here.
definitions.last_30: States 269 to 299 inclusive of 30 subsequent transitions. Every late plant or seizure is followed in its first continuous tenure until expiry, opponent seizure or end, credited only actual cash from terrain, enemy cargo absorption and tree collision. Direct cash categories carry signs; absorption_from_* subdivide tree_absorption, so do not add them twice. The opening t0 tree inventory is already included in the all-owner cash totals. Intercepted cargo on surviving workers is not cash. Treasury rounding is accounted separately at player level; no sale credit.
